script.title: Imperial Star Destroyer - Devastator
script.description: UCS-scale Imperial-class Star Destroyer with terraced command superstructure, dual deflector shield globes, tractor beam mast, heavy turbolaser barbettes, lateral brim trench greebles, ventral hangar bay capturing the Tantive IV, triple primary ion engine cluster, and architectural display stand.

check.health: warning: 4043 parts with verified connectors form 178 separately connected groups; 27 parts are not connected to anything. 7 parts have no verified connector data (custom, tilted or not yet verified); they may join these groups.
